run_eval_runner: run the EvalRunner to evaluate a model using an EvalUnit and dataloader with optional callbacks
create_eval_runner: create an EvalRunner instance with a dataloader, EvalUnit, callbacks, and optional max steps per epoch
save_eval_state: save the EvalRunner state to a checkpoint location during preemption events
load_eval_state: load the EvalRunner state from a checkpoint location to resume evaluation
review_eval_runner_class: review the EvalRunner class that extends Runner and delegates evaluation to torchtnt evaluate
